summary: Closed the weakest point in the new account by reading the leader's own request builder: at nextIndex one it sets the previous index and term to zero and copies the leader's entries from index one up to nextIndex+MaxAppendEntries-1 or the last index, so the whole-log request the follower refused is the shape a live leader produces at that point of the stair. Added the source anchor (replication.go 570-628) and a behavior knowledge entry for that builder, and rewrote the account's counterevidence so the refused request's reachability is credited to the leader's own path while the walk to nextIndex one, its duration, and the stale index's effect on the follower's vote responses stay unmeasured. Validation returned valid with those effects and no execution requested.
